question: Karim and Bablu can build a wooden table in 3 days. Bablu can do it alone in 5 days. How many days would it take Karim to do this job alone?

🔖Bablu can build 1/5 of the table in a day.
Together they can build 1/3 of the table in a day.
Therefore, Karim can build (1/3 - 1/5 = 2/15) of the table in a day.
So, Karim can build the complete table in 15/2 = 7.5 days

bablu's work rate per day = 1/5 (as he takes 5 days alone)

(1/x) + (1/5) = 1/3
⇒ (5 + x)/5x = 1/3
⇒ 15 + 3x = 5x
⇒ 15 + 3x - 5x = 0
⇒ 15 - 2x = 0
⇒ 2x = 15
∴ x = 7.5
